reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 307.519720 m² remainder (0.2041%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. It forms 12 pieces, with mean widths of 0.21–1.18 m for those of at least 1 m². 51.971008 m² lies between parcels inside the outline and the rest along its edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 307.519720 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list names Les Bonnes Mares as the cru's only climat.
